ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: From the problem text, there are 10 branches total. Each branch has either 5 leaves only, or 2 leaves and 1 flower. Let x be the number of branches with 2 leaves and 1 flower. Then the other 10 - x branches have 5 leaves each. The total number of leaves is 2x + 5(10 - x) = 2x + 50 - 5x = 50 - 3x. To have 31 leaves, we would need 50 - 3x = 31. Then 3x = 19, so x = 19/3. Since x must be a whole number of branches, this is impossible. Therefore the bush cannot have exactly 31 leaves.
